_note: Hand-kept list of external tools the departments can use. build-catalog.py merges it with agents/ and skills/. 'check' is a shell command whose success means the tool is present; 'cost' is free / byo-key / paid (quote + owner yes).

tools.can: public YouTube/Instagram metadata, playlists, transcripts where available, video files for analysis
frames, contact sheets, cuts, loudness (ebur128), encodes
deterministic 3D scenes via bpy, previews, renders
channel and video statistics, uploads list, comments (quota-limited)
YouTube Studio / Instagram Insights CSV exports or screenshots the owner provides
image, image-to-video, reference-to-video, text-to-video through whatever MCP connector or web tool the owner has; routing in policies/model-routing.yaml
voice-over generation or a human VO plan
compositing and timeline work via scripting (optional)
outliers, keyword research, competitor stats (account-bound; test before promising)
